services.desc: Take your game to the next level with private tennis lessons at Camargo Racquet Club. Whether you’re picking up a racquet for the first time, returning to the game after time away, or looking to sharpen your skills for league, tournament, or high school competition, our experienced teaching professionals are here to help. Private lessons provide individualized instruction designed around your specific goals. From stroke development and strategy to footwork, consistency, and match play, our pros will create a personalized plan to help you improve faster and gain confidence on the court. blurb: Camargo Racquet Club has been family-owned since 1972, making us one of Cincinnati’s oldest and most established indoor tennis clubs. For over 50 years, we have built a tradition around exceptional tennis, community, and a welcoming atmosphere for players of all ages and skill levels. Our facility features ten indoor hard courts, providing year-round play in a premier indoor setting.
